trigger: CREATE TRIGGER mission_project_stage_scope_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON public.mission_institution_stages FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION mission_project_stage_scope_guard()
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mission_project_stage_scope_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if tg_op='UPDATE' and new.institution_id is distinct from old.institution_id and exists(select 1 from public.expansion_institutions where id=old.institution_id and actionables_reference is not null) then raise exception 'Project stages stay with their institution';end if;
 return new;
end $function$

trigger: CREATE TRIGGER mission_reopen_delivery AFTER UPDATE ON public.mission_institution_stages FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION mission_reopen_delivery()
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mission_reopen_delivery()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if old.completed_at is not null and new.completed_at is null and new.stage_key is distinct from 'handover' then
  update public.mission_institution_stages set completed_at=null,completed_by=null where institution_id=new.institution_id and stage_key='handover' and completed_at is not null;
 end if;return new;
end $function$

definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mission_reopen_stage_for_work()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if new.status<>'done' then
  update public.mission_institution_stages set completed_at=null,completed_by=null where completed_at is not null and (id=new.institution_stage_id or (institution_id=new.institution_id and stage_key='handover'));
 end if;return new;
end $function$
